notes.title: Exclusive playtest: you're invited!
notes.notes: [p]Hi friends![/p][p][/p][p]There's a series of playtests coming up in the next few weeks as preparation for [b]1.0 launch[/b]![/p][p]The goal is to gather feedback and data about the game's balance and progression curve. [/p][p][b]Limited to 10 participants for now[/b][/p][p]If you'd like to participate, join our discord here: [url="https://discord.gg/8xAhug7gFn"]https://discord.gg/8xAhug7gFn[/url][/p][p]All information will be provided there.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p]
